### 1 — Scene
A mixed buffet-style meal: pepperoni pizza, sliced roast meat, vegetables, a few salad leaves, and what appear to be pieces of bread at the top.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using a circular approximation, its area is **3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm²**. The cropped edges make the scale somewhat uncertain.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The upper pieces are tentatively identified as bread; the browned vegetables appear to include potato and eggplant. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate, and any roasting oil is included in the vegetables’ energy density.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Pepperoni pizza | 19% | 109 cm² × 1.2 cm = 131 ml | 0.9 | 118 g | 280 | 330 kcal |
| Sliced roast meat | 12% | 69 cm² × 1.5 cm = 104 ml | 0.95 | 99 g | 220 | 218 kcal |
| Cauliflower | 7% | 40 cm² × 2.4 cm = 96 ml | 0.6 | 58 g | 30 | 17 kcal |
| Roasted potato and eggplant | 10% | 57 cm² × 2 cm = 114 ml | 0.6 | 68 g | 120 | 82 kcal |
| Bread pieces | 12% | 69 cm² × 2 cm = 138 ml | 0.3 | 41 g | 260 | 107 kcal |
| Rocket/arugula leaves | 2% | 11 cm² × 1 cm = 11 ml | 0.15 | 2 g | 25 | 1 kcal |

### 8 — Sanity check
The areas sum to **62% of the plate**, consistent with the visible uncovered space. An estimated **386 g and 755 kcal** is plausible for this assortment; the few leaves contribute very little weight. Bread identification and hidden food thickness are the main uncertainties.
